parts.label: (a)
parts.stem:
During translation, a polypeptide is synthesised when amino acids are added to a growing chain of amino acids.

Fig. 1.1 shows part of a growing chain of amino acids and the amino acid cysteine.

{{figure:figure_1_1.webp}}

Fig. 1.1

parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.text: Complete Fig. 1.1 by showing the formation of the bond between cysteine and the growing chain of amino acids in the process of translation.

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.text: State the name of the covalent bond that forms when cysteine is added to the growing chain of amino acids.

parts.label: (a)(iii)
parts.text: State the organelle where the reaction shown in Fig. 1.1 takes place.

parts.text: Describe the secondary structure of the protein shown in Fig. 1.2.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: Explain why the protein shown in Fig. 1.2 has tertiary structure, but not quaternary structure.

parts.label: (b)(iii)
parts.text:
An analysis of the amino acid composition of the protein in Fig. 1.2 showed that it does **not** contain any cysteine residues.

Explain how the three-dimensional structure of the protein shown in Fig. 1.2 is held in place.
